name: The One Step Rule
subtitle: How to Accomplish Anything Without Burnout
description: Most of us believe big achievements come from doing a lot of things every day. But real progress happens by completing just one small, meaningful task—something that directly pushes a goal forward. Trying to do everything at once can be overwhelming, but focusing on just one essential task each day leads to consistent growth over time.
